record.title: Domestic Induction Cooking Appliances - Safety and Performance
record.description:
Specifies safety, electrical, thermal, and functional performance requirements for freestanding and countertop domestic induction cooking appliances supplied for household use.

Applies to induction hobs and portable induction cookers designed for household cooking; excludes commercial catering equipment and laboratory heating equipment.

Key requirements: Electrical insulation and protective measures shall meet the specified safety criteria.; Accessible surfaces shall remain within defined temperature limits during declared use.; The appliance shall safely detect or respond to abnormal operating conditions.

Testing: Dielectric strength and insulation verification.; Temperature rise testing under representative load.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a product-specific control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity assessment may be voluntary.
